about: Lint runner and rule mutants (wf10 LINT0). Each is killed by the package's seeded properties: TestSuppressionAgreesWithModel (runner, configuration, directive grammar) and the per-rule reference properties.

mutants.name: lint0-unchecked-runs-rules
mutants.rule: On unchecked source no rule runs and every known directive is not-evaluated: unchecked-source.

mutants.name: lint0-covers-own-line
mutants.rule: A directive covers the next line, not its own.

mutants.name: lint0-unused-not-reported
mutants.rule: An unused suppression of a completed rule is an L001 error.

mutants.name: lint0-reserved-namespace-admitted
mutants.rule: A directive in a reserved namespace (ergo/, builtin/) is unknown: L001.

mutants.name: lint0-off-rule-unused
mutants.rule: A directive of an off rule is not-evaluated: rule-off, never unused.

mutants.name: lint0-failed-rule-unused
mutants.rule: A directive of a failed rule is not-evaluated: facts-unavailable; a rule that did not complete proves nothing unused.

mutants.name: lint0-failure-complete
mutants.rule: A failed rule makes the run incomplete, which fails policy.

mutants.name: lint0-panic-passes
mutants.rule: A rule that panics fails with L000; it never completes clean.

mutants.name: lint0-bad-span-passes
mutants.rule: A rule that reports outside its file fails with L000.

mutants.name: lint0-suppression-keeps-finding
mutants.rule: An applied directive removes the findings it covers.

mutants.name: lint0-severity-dropped
mutants.from: f.Code, f.Rule, f.Severity = rule.Code, rule.Name, severity
mutants.to: f.Code, f.Rule, f.Severity = rule.Code, rule.Name, rule.Default
mutants.rule: A finding carries the configured severity, not the rule's default.

mutants.name: lint0-options-only-stays-off
mutants.rule: A setting with no severity turns an off rule on at its default.

mutants.name: lint0-presets-ignored
mutants.rule: The command line's presets are layers after extends and before the document's rules.

mutants.name: lint0-reason-optional
mutants.rule: A directive without a reason is malformed (L001).

mutants.name: lint0-two-rules-admitted
mutants.rule: A directive names one rule.

mutants.name: lint0-glued-word-directive
mutants.rule: A comment whose first word only starts with the directive word is no directive.

mutants.name: lint0-silent-return-ignored
mutants.rule: An arm that returns leaves a trace.

mutants.name: lint0-silent-try-ignored
mutants.rule: An arm that fails on through try leaves a trace.

mutants.name: lint0-silent-footprint-ignored
mutants.rule: An arm that calls anything with an effect leaves a trace.

mutants.name: lint0-silent-reads-ignored
mutants.rule: An arm that reads its failure binding is not silent.

mutants.name: lint0-silent-enters-literals
mutants.rule: A return inside a function literal is that literal's frame, not the arm's.

mutants.name: lint0-fep-unexported
mutants.rule: Only an exported function is a public boundary.

mutants.name: lint0-fep-any-error
mutants.rule: The rule matches go.Error by identity, not the program's own error types.

mutants.name: lint1-fws-any-go
mutants.to: if covering, ok := std.CoveredBy(im.Pkg.Path); ok || im.Pkg.Host() {
mutants.rule: foreign-where-std fires only on Go packages std's coverage table names.

mutants.name: lint1-fws-std-import
mutants.rule: An import of std's own package (strings) is not raw Go, whatever its path spells.

mutants.name: lint1-dep-same-package
mutants.rule: A use inside the declaring package is not reported.

mutants.name: lint1-dep-no-ops
mutants.rule: A call of a deprecated operation is a use of it.

mutants.name: lint1-dep-prose
mutants.rule: Only a paragraph that starts with the fact's word (Deprecated:, Unbounded:) states the fact; the word inside prose does not.

mutants.name: lint1-uc-let-ignored
mutants.from: return isVar && known && depth < 8 && unbounded(value, depth+1)
mutants.to: return isVar && known && depth < 0 && unbounded(value, depth+1)
mutants.rule: A let bound to an unbounded producer is that producer's Seq.

mutants.name: lint1-uc-any-doc
mutants.rule: The fact is the Unbounded: paragraph, not any doc comment.

mutants.name: lint1-uc-break-ignored
mutants.rule: A loop that can break is not collecting everything.

mutants.name: lint1-uc-inner-break
mutants.rule: A break of an inner loop does not leave the outer one.

mutants.name: lint1-uc-no-append
mutants.rule: A loop that handles each value without appending is not a collection.

mutants.name: lint1-rft-both-sleep
mutants.rule: A race of two sleeps has no body to put under a timeout.

mutants.name: lint1-rft-effect-fallback
mutants.rule: A block that sleeps and then runs an effect is not a plain fallback.

mutants.name: lint1-rft-expired-fixed
mutants.rule: No fix when the race already fails timeout.Expired: the fix's catch would take it.

mutants.name: lint1-rft-any-race
mutants.rule: Only std's tasks.Race, by identity, not a program function spelled Race.

mutants.name: lint1-cog-nesting
mutants.rule: Cognitive complexity adds the nesting level to a nested if.

mutants.name: lint1-cog-else
mutants.rule: An else adds one to cognitive complexity.

mutants.name: lint1-cog-runs
mutants.rule: A run of like boolean operators adds one, not one per operator.

mutants.name: lint1-cyc-bool
mutants.from:
if node.Op == syntax.LAND || node.Op == syntax.LOR {
				n++
mutants.rule: Each && and || is a path of cyclomatic complexity.

mutants.name: lint1-cyc-case
mutants.rule: Each match case is a path of cyclomatic complexity.

mutants.name: lint1-hal-distinct
mutants.rule: Halstead counts distinct operands by their text.

mutants.name: lint1-options-ignored
mutants.rule: A configured option replaces the rule's default.

mutants.name: lint1-kvw-mut
mutants.rule: A let mut keeps a union for a later variant.

mutants.name: lint1-kvw-any-type
mutants.rule: Only a variant put into its union widens; a let of the variant's own type does not.

mutants.name: lint1-bw-uses
mutants.rule: banned-words reads declarations, not uses.

mutants.name: lint1-bw-no-case-split
mutants.rule: A camel-case name splits into words at case changes.

mutants.name: lint1-wae-entry
mutants.rule: cmd/NAME/main.ergo is where providers are chosen.

mutants.name: lint1-wae-listed
mutants.rule: A function option functions lists may choose providers.

mutants.name: lint1-wae-test-file
mutants.rule: A file of tests and laws, helpers included, picks implementations freely.

mutants.name: lint1-wae-passed-down

if conv.Kind != 0 && conv.From != nil {
					out = append(out, conv.From)
mutants.to:
if conv.Kind == conv.Kind {
					out = append(out, e.Caps...)
mutants.rule: A capability value passed down picks no implementation.

mutants.name: lint1-dep-qualified
mutants.from: if o := check.QualifiedMember(p.Info, n); o != nil {
mutants.rule: A qualified use pkg.Name of a deprecated declaration is a use.

mutants.name: lint1-cfn-no-suffix
mutants.rule: A file named NAME_service.ergo is named for a kind.
